messages:
Ivy: Quick sync: SI partner (Atlas Integrations) requested a walkthrough of our SI certification flow + marketplace tile before public launch. Can eng, ops, and marketing join a dry-run at 08:30 PT tomorrow? Need to validate badge provisioning, SKU mapping, and rollback.
Tom: 08:30 PT works. I9ll bring the SKU manifest and the listing schema. We should pre-provision the partner-only badge and then flip public during the dry-run.
Renee: Ops: recommend pre-provision partners-only, run flag flip test, then simulate ingestion failure and rollback. I9ll prepare a short runbook.
sam-ops-bot: Flag detected: `si_badge_visibility` (default: partners_only). Endpoint for flip: POST /flags/si_badge_visibility {"value":"public"}.
Ivy: Marketing needs final quote and 3 screenshots by 07:45 PT to prep assets. Partner legal okayed the quote with a small compliance blurb. Share under embargo.
Tom: Attaching SKUs inline: ATLS-GPU-A1, ATLS-ACC-02, ATLS-TPU-SLIM. Also demo env: staging-sis-2026.
Renee: Runbook snippet for flip & rollback: ```bash
# flip to public
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" https://internal/flags/si_badge_visibility -d '{"value":"public"}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://internal/flags/si_badge_visibility -d '{"value":"partners_only"}'
```
partner-pm: Can you include a simulated failure so our ops team sees recovery? We want to practice customer comms.
Ivy: Yes. Schedule: 08:30 intros, 08:35 demo, 08:45 flip dry-run, 08:48 simulate failure & rollback, 09:00 retrospective. Keep comments minimal during run.
Tom: I9ll invalidate CDN cache as part of the flip step.
Renee: Deck + one-pager checklist uploaded to calendar. Please review before EOD.
Ivy: Thanks. Meeting invite created 1: "Atlas SI dry-run - marketplace & badge" 08:30 PT. See you tomorrow.
partner-pm: Thanks all, will join the last 10 minutes for alignment.
